title: StackStartResult
description: A start that ran to its end: the stack as status reads it afterwards. A start that failed is an error, whatever it started before it did; its progress lines say what it did.

knowledgeBase.description: The started knowledge base's stack, as status reads it after the start. Absent from a dry run, and from a start of services no knowledge base owns.

shared.description: The shared services, as status reads them after the start. Absent from a dry run.
